# TechTarget
> TechTarget is a global network of enterprise technology and healthcare media sites publishing news, definitions, expert guidance and product-focused analysis.

TechTarget organizes coverage across specialized brands and topic hubs for IT professionals, security teams, developers, data leaders, healthcare organizations and business decision-makers. Its sites combine news reporting, tutorials, trend analysis, buying advice and extensive technical definitions.

## Core Network
- [TechTarget Home](https://www.techtarget.com/): Main portal to TechTarget’s enterprise technology and healthcare content network.
- [Enterprise Technology News](https://www.techtarget.com/news): Cross-topic news hub covering AI, security, cloud, data and infrastructure.
- [WhatIs](https://www.techtarget.com/whatis/): Technical definitions, explainers and reference articles for IT and business concepts.
- [Tech Accelerator](https://www.techtarget.com/techtargetaccelerator): Product-led guides and practical advice for evaluating enterprise technologies.
- [Informa TechTarget](https://www.techtarget.com/informa-techtarget): Corporate information about the combined Informa TechTarget business.

## AI and Data
- [Enterprise AI](https://www.techtarget.com/searchenterpriseai): News and guidance on enterprise AI, generative AI, ML and data science.
- [Data Management](https://www.techtarget.com/searchdatamanagement): Coverage of databases, governance, integration, analytics and data architecture.
- [Business Analytics](https://www.techtarget.com/searchbusinessanalytics): Reporting and advice on BI, analytics platforms and data-driven decision-making.
- [Data Center](https://www.techtarget.com/searchdatacenter): Infrastructure and operations coverage including storage, servers and facilities.
- [IoT Agenda](https://www.techtarget.com/iotagenda): News and explainers on IoT platforms, edge computing and connected devices.

## Security
- [Information Security](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsecurity): Cybersecurity news, strategy, threat analysis and security technology guidance.
- [Security Videos](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsecurity/videos): Video explainers and interviews on security trends and best practices.
- [Security Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsecurity/definitions): Security glossary entries covering threats, controls and compliance terminology.
- [Security Resources](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsecurity/resources): Curated security guides, tutorials and topic collections.
- [HealthTech Security](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechsecurity): Healthcare cybersecurity coverage focused on HIPAA, ransomware and risk management.

## Cloud, Infrastructure and Networking
- [Cloud Computing](https://www.techtarget.com/searchcloudcomputing): News and guidance on public cloud, hybrid cloud and cloud-native operations.
- [AWS](https://www.techtarget.com/searchaws): AWS-focused news, tutorials and architecture guidance for enterprise teams.
- [Azure](https://www.techtarget.com/searchwindowsserver): Microsoft infrastructure coverage including Windows Server, Azure-adjacent administration and management.
- [Networking](https://www.techtarget.com/searchnetworking): Enterprise networking coverage spanning LAN, WAN, wireless and network operations.
- [IT Operations](https://www.techtarget.com/searchitoperations): Guidance on IT service delivery, observability, automation and operations management.
- [Storage](https://www.techtarget.com/searchstorage): Storage systems, backup, disaster recovery and data protection coverage.

## Software Development and Applications
- [Software Quality](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsoftwarequality): Software development, testing, DevOps and application lifecycle management guidance.
- [App Architecture](https://www.techtarget.com/searchapparchitecture): Application design, microservices, APIs and modern architecture patterns.
- [ERP](https://www.techtarget.com/searcherp): ERP strategy, implementation guidance and enterprise application market coverage.
- [CRM](https://www.techtarget.com/searchcustomerexperience): Customer experience and CRM-related coverage for digital engagement teams.
- [Content Management](https://www.techtarget.com/searchcontentmanagement): Enterprise content, collaboration and information management guidance.

## IT Strategy and Leadership
- [CIO](https://www.techtarget.com/searchcio): IT leadership coverage on strategy, governance, budgets and digital transformation.
- [IT Knowledge Exchange](https://itknowledgeexchange.techtarget.com/): Community blogs and practitioner perspectives across enterprise IT topics.
- [Sustainability](https://www.techtarget.com/sustainability): Coverage of ESG, green IT and sustainability strategy in technology organizations.
- [Computer Weekly](https://www.computerweekly.com/): UK-focused enterprise IT news, analysis and buyer-oriented coverage.
- [TechTarget Editorial Topics](https://www.techtarget.com/topics): Directory of topic hubs across the TechTarget network.

## Healthcare Technology
- [Health IT](https://www.techtarget.com/searchhealthit): Healthcare IT news and analysis on EHRs, interoperability and provider technology.
- [HealthTech Analytics](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics): Healthcare analytics, AI, data governance and population health coverage.
- [Virtual Healthcare](https://www.techtarget.com/virtualhealthcare): Telehealth, remote care and digital health delivery guidance.
- [Patient Engagement](https://www.techtarget.com/patientengagement): Strategies and technologies for patient communication and experience.
- [Healthcare Payers](https://www.techtarget.com/healthcarepayers): Payer operations, policy, claims and insurance technology coverage.
- [Revenue Cycle Management](https://www.techtarget.com/revcyclemanagement): Billing, reimbursement, coding and revenue cycle technology guidance.
- [Pharma Life Sciences](https://www.techtarget.com/pharmalifesciences): Drug development, clinical data and life sciences technology reporting.

## Definitions and Reference
- [WhatIs Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/whatis/definitions): Alphabetized IT definitions and concept explainers across enterprise technology.
- [Enterprise AI Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchenterpriseai/definitions): AI and machine learning terminology for enterprise practitioners.
- [Data Management Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchdatamanagement/definitions): Definitions for databases, governance, integration and analytics concepts.
- [Cloud Computing Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchcloudcomputing/definitions): Cloud architecture, services and operations terminology.
- [Networking Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchnetworking/definitions): Networking concepts, protocols and infrastructure terminology.
- [Security Definitions](https://www.techtarget.com/searchsecurity/definitions): Cybersecurity terms covering attacks, defenses and compliance topics.

## Multimedia and Special Formats
- [Videos](https://www.techtarget.com/video): Video hub for interviews, explainers and enterprise technology analysis.
- [Podcasts](https://www.techtarget.com/podcasts): Podcast directory featuring discussions on major technology topics.
- [Photo Stories](https://www.techtarget.com/photostory): Visual explainers and slide-based summaries of technology topics.
- [Quizzes](https://www.techtarget.com/quiz): Interactive quizzes testing knowledge of enterprise technology concepts.
- [Features](https://www.techtarget.com/feature): Long-form feature reporting and in-depth analysis across TechTarget brands.

## Topic Discovery
- [Artificial Intelligence Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Artificial-Intelligence): Aggregated AI coverage from across TechTarget sites and brands.
- [Cybersecurity Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Security): Aggregated security news, definitions and expert guidance.
- [Cloud Computing Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Cloud-Computing): Cross-site cloud coverage including strategy, platforms and operations.
- [Data Management Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Data-Management): Aggregated content on data platforms, governance and analytics.
- [Networking Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Networking): Cross-network coverage of enterprise networking technologies and practices.
- [Healthcare Topic](https://www.techtarget.com/topics/Healthcare): Aggregated healthcare IT and digital health coverage.
